zh: 囚犯已单独收容，选择一项珍藏后继续经营。
en: The Inmate is housed separately. Choose a Warden’s Treasure to continue.

en: Hatches into a {1} Colossal Rat after {0} day changes; opening the cell early clears the nest.

en: Opening this cell reveals a Special Incident, which you may accept or skip
The incident type is not revealed in advance.

en: Opened Cell {0}: {1}. Reveal / Scratch Marks indicators cleared.
